text: As the Toronto Transit Commission operates a transit service on Anglesey Boulevard, City Council approval of this report is required. The purpose of this report is to install a "No Parking Anytime" regulation on the north side of Anglesey Boulevard from a point 55 metres east of The Kingsway and a point 12 metres further east. The proposed parking amendment was requested by a resident whose driveway is consistently blocked by vehicles parking outside of the designated parking area.

City Council on February 26, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the north side of Anglesey Boulevard, between a point 55 metres east of The Kingsway and a point 12 metres further east. 2. City Council rescind the existing parking machine regulation in effect at all times for a maximum period of 24 hours, at a rate of $1.00 and for a maximum period of 12 hours, on the north side of Anglesey Boulevard, between a point 55 metres east of The Kingsway and a point 12 metres further east.
